name: ghost
description: Local-first MCP memory server for Claude Code on macOS and Linux: one SQLite file, hybrid search, on-demand consolidation. Bundles the platform binary, so there is nothing else to install. (Native Windows: install ghost-windows-amd64 or ghost-windows-arm64 from this marketplace, or run `ghost mcp init` with the standalone binary.) First-run setup is automatic and persistent: it disables Claude Code's built-in file memory, imports memories from projects Ghost already knows (others import on first use), and writes MEMORY.md redirects in known projects — these changes remain if you uninstall the plugin. The stop-hook save reminder is on by default; the LLM consolidation passes (`reflect`/`resolve`/`supersede`) are opt-in and off by default.
